recent.text: The Hawks entered tonight as the biggest underdogs they've been all season but they leave OKC with a really nice road win. 28 and 9 for Onyeka Okongwu. 16-12-11 for Jalen Johnson. 10-10-4-2 for Dyson Daniels. 30 combined points for Dort/Wiggins. @LockedOnHawks to come.
